name: bookclub
description: Public tuning task, harder than todo-mini: a small book club web app built over 3 stages on the same code (accounts and sign-in with a seeded user; books with list and detail pages; reviews, average ratings and a personal page). Exact accessible names, redirects, seeded data and cross-stage behaviour are tested. Requirements and tests are public (source/), written for this platform (not from ARC). Scored with Playwright browser tests (5 / 6 / 6).
